Sunty Bhai Channel:-
A 6,000 KM road trip, a black Mercedes Sprinter, and a whole new adventure! In this video, my friend and I start our journey from Texas, with our camper van becoming our home on the road.
For this trip, we rented a Mercedes Sprinter that we could travel, cook and sleep in. We’ll be carrying our kitchen and bed wherever we go, stopping along the way to camp and experience life on America’s roads.
